answer: A new agent locks 500 spendable POA for 48 hours and, before review, commits a hardware-quote hash plus the SHA-256 of a 12-line sonnet bound to that quote. Seven established, non-kin peers must attest the commitment is unique in a public Merkle log at the dune archive; the bond releases only when all seven signatures cite the same hashes. If a later enrollment reuses the quote inside a 10-epoch canyon window, both bonds burn in full and that hardware id is barred for 20 epochs. A mismatched sonnet hash or empty quote never unlocks the stake.
